sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Integration of Programmable Logic Controllers for Industrial Grids

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (mixed with Islamic Sharia principles; code-based Napoleonic heritage)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt–European Union Partnership and Development Cooperation Agreement (2001/2004)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 regarding Combating Money Laundering, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014; Executive Regulations thereof; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 44 of 2021 introducing the statutory Beneficial Ownership Register; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT instructions; Ministry of Investment decree for disclosure of UBOs.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the direct corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial Registry / Companies House in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Egyptian Consulate/Embassy (Egypt is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Shareholders authorizing formation of the Egyptian LLC and appointment of the local manager/authorized representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Verified Source of Wealth/Funds Statement for each 25% ultimate beneficiary
Certified Copies of Passports of all shareholders and managers, with photographs notarized
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Notary Public in the shareholders' jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by Egyptian consular authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, and authorized signatory against the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) domestic list, United Nations Security Council sanctions resolutions (1267/1988 and 1718), OFAC SDN list, European Union consolidated list, and publicly available PEP databases; enhanced due diligence required for PEPs and for commercial relationships with high-risk jurisdictions; results must be documented and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Commercial Registry 'Investor Portal' (www.gafi.gov.eg); in-person Commercial Registry offices under the Ministry of Interior.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every corporate name must include an Arabic-language denomination and be registered in Arabic script. A secondary non-Arabic (e.g., English) name is permitted only as a transliteration of the Arabic name and cannot be an independent commercial name. The name must be distinctive, not misleading, and not contrary to public order or decency.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An extension of the name reservation may be applied through GAFI before expiry and is subject to the same 30-day renewal fee. If the name is rejected, the applicant may lodge an administrative appeal with GAFI's Commercial Registry Director within 15 days of notification; if the rejection is upheld, a judicial appeal may be filed before the Administrative Court (Council of State) within sixty days from the final administrative rejection, accompanied by legal representation and payment of judicial fees.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. Licensed virtual office addresses and flexible workspaces are accepted by GAFI for LLC registration provided the lease agreement is submitted and the provider is a licensed real-estate agent. However, an actual physical office will be required if the company enters into public-sector contracts, executes on-site SCADA/substation integration services, or when the corporate bank requires a site inspection.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; a 15–30% probability of registry or tax-authority physical verification during the first year, rising if the registered office is virtual or if commercial-substance indicators are triggered under FATF risk-based supervision.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the Memorandum of Association and Commercial Registry registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Notary Public / GAFI Commercial Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff plus notary fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication fees in the Egyptian Commercial Gazette
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official advertisement tariff based on document page count

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of foreign corporate documents (certificate of incorporation, board resolution, UBO declarations)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Egyptian Consulate in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular fee per document (approx. USD 50–90 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register filing and AML/CFT compliance screening support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee plus fixed compliance support fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered office using a licensed virtual office address in Cairo
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed virtual office provider / commercial agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a business address subscription (EGP 15,000–18,000/year)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel for pre-incorporation due diligence, PEP/sanctions screening, drafting and bank introduction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee market benchmark for LLC formation and compliance package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Economic Law No. 4 of 2009 and Companies Law No. 148 of 2019), Articles 54-67 (Limited Liability Companies), and Executive Regulations No. 96 of 1982; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for GAFI one-stop procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop, Cairo, in coordination with the Commercial Registry Authority and the Egyptian Tax Authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Incorporation Contract (Aqd El-Taasis) and Articles of Association (El-Nizam El-Assasi), filed with GAFI for issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Law 4 of 2009; capital is freely set by the shareholders in the Incorporation Contract and may be paid in installments. No escrow or bank capital deposit certificate is mandatory unless shareholders elect to evidence paid-in contributions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of the founding shareholders of the Company (the "Company"): 1. The Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association, as notarized before the competent Notary Public, are ratified and adopted in full, and the appended share subscription list is confirmed as the Company's capital schedule. 2. The Company's registered office is established at the address stated in the Incorporation Contract, Cairo Governorate; the Managing Director is authorized to execute the lease and file notice thereof with GAFI. 3. The subscriber named in the contract is appointed General Manager, acting as sole legal representative, with authority to open bank accounts, execute instruments, and sign statutory filings. 4. GAFI is authorized to complete the incorporation registration and issue the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name screening and preliminary reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online name reservation application on the GAFI digital platform, indicating the proposed Arabic and English trade names of the LLC. The system checks the Commercial Registry index for identical or deceptively similar names. Upon approval, download and retain the name reservation certificate. The name shall follow the format '[Company Name] for Engineering and Electrical Works LLC'.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (online)
Passport copies of all founding shareholders
Board of Directors/managers consent letter (if appointing a third-party manager)
Lease contract or preliminary lease title for the registered office location
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity with an existing registration, submit a revised name application within 15 days through the same portal; no additional fee is levied for the first substitution request. If the rejection is due to incomplete shareholder data, correct the entries and refile immediately in the same business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and authentication of the Incorporation Contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (El-Shahr El-Akari), Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bilingual Arabic/English Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association. All founders or their lawful attorneys must appear in person before the Notary Public with original identity documents. The notary authenticates signatures, verifies legal capacity, and affixes the official notarial seal. Stamp duties and notarial fees are paid at the notary office, and the instrument is entered in the notarial register.
required_dossiers: Draft Incorporation Contract in Arabic (3 originals)
Name reservation certificate issued by GAFI
Original passport or national ID of each founder
Power of attorney (if signed by representatives)
Capital contribution schedule and share allocation table
Witness identification documents, if required by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies discrepancies in names, national IDs, or signatures, the founders must execute a corrective addendum (at-Ta'dil) and re-notarize the corrected pages in the same notary session. Minor administrative defects do not require restarting the dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI incorporation certificate and automatic commercial registry enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Kasr El-Nil Branch), Cairo
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Incorporation Contract and complete the standard GAFI LLC incorporation dossier at the One-Stop Shop. The OSS officer registers the company in the Electronic Commercial Registry, issues the Certificate of Incorporation, assigns a commercial registration number, and requests the Tax Authority to issue a temporary tax card. All formalities (tax card, commercial registration, and chamber of commerce election) are processed concurrently within the OSS premises.
required_dossiers: Notarized Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association (original plus two copies)
Name reservation certificate
Commercial registry application form signed by the General Manager
Lease contract or proof of legal right to use the premises
Founder passports and Egyptian national IDs, as applicable
Legal representative (General Manager) appointment and acceptance letter
Capital contribution declaration (bank certificate optional; not mandatory)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query, the OSS Customer Service Counter for objections and corrections (Counter 14) accepts supplementary clarifications within 15 working days from notification. Failure to respond within that period requires a fresh incorporation filing; however, most queries relate to address verification and are cured by producing the notarized lease and signed building owner consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and VAT/payroll account establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Income Tax and Value Added Tax Departments via GAFI OSS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The temporary tax card is generated automatically upon incorporation. Subsequently, attend the ETA window to finalize the permanent tax card, obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN), and register for VAT if the actual or projected taxable supply exceeds the VAT registration threshold (EGP 1,000,000 annually for goods; EGP 500,000 for services; lower limits may apply per Decree No. 34 of 2023). Register for payroll and stamp duty accounts for the hired staff.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial registry extract (electronic record)
Permanent tax card application form (S77)
General Manager national ID or passport
Lease contract and registered office title
Bank account opening certificate (once the corporate bank account is opened)
VAT registration form if threshold is met or expected
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax card is issued with an incorrect name or address, submit a correction application to the ETA inspection office together with the Certificate of Incorporation and a copy of the lease; correction is processed within 5 working days. VAT registration denials due to threshold miscalculation can be contested by submitting projected service contracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social insurance, labor office, and municipal registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI); Governorate Labor Office; Industrial Licensing Authority (if site operations commence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, register the company as an employer with NOSI using Form 2 (company registration) and Form 1 (employee registration) within 30 days of the first hiring. File an application with the competent Labor Office to open the labor file and enroll the employment contract list. If the company intends to operate an administrative or installation support office, register the activity with the local governorate and obtain the business license and signage permit.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and commercial registry extract
Permanent tax card
General Manager national ID and proof of appointment
Employment contracts of founding and first employees
Lease contract and premises suitability report for labor safety
Form 1 and Form 2 social insurance registration forms
Governorate business license application and fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI issues a late registration penalty, present the date of the Certificate of Incorporation and payroll start date as evidence; a voluntary disclosure letter can waive penalties where no employees were engaged prior. Labor Office queries concerning unexecuted employment contracts are cured by correcting the contract forms in a single visit and paying a nominal documentation fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy, Engineering Licensing Sector, in coordination with the Egyptian Society for Electrical Contractors and the Egyptian Engineers Syndicate for contractor classification
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Electrical Installation Contractor Classification Certificate (SCADA / Instrumentation and Control Category) and Site Electrical Works Permit issued by the competent Electricity Distribution Company

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Impact Assessment Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (Registration / Exempt) - SCADA integration, substation automation and commissioning of pre-wired panels do not trigger a Full EIA Report; a brief EIA screening form is required only when the works include erection of new high-voltage substations above 66 kV, transformer oil storage exceeding 500 liters, or land disturbance over 5 hectares.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 and Law No. 48 of 1982: wastewater discharged to public sewer must meet pH 6-9, BOD 350 mg/L, COD 700 mg/L, TSS 425 mg/L, and oil/grease 100 mg/L per Ministerial Decree 92/2013; transformer oil handling must comply with EEAA hazardous waste manifest requirements for oil-contaminated rags and spent oil; no stationary combustion sources are installed, so VOC and stack emission thresholds under Ministerial Decree 44/2000 apply only to temporary diesel generators used during commissioning, with a particulate matter limit of 100 mg/m3 and sulfur dioxide of 100 ppm.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Authority certification under Civil Defense Law No. 12 of 1981, covering firefighting systems at storage, testing and staging areas; structural load clearance from the competent governorate engineering department for permanent office fit-out and equipment racks; Ministry of Manpower occupational health and safety inspection under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, including first aid kit, fire extinguisher, personnel protective equipment, electrical grounding and arc flash protection compliance for commissioning works.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Ministry of Finance; e-Tax Portal: einvoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a resident tax agent/fiscal representative and submit to ETA: commercial registry certificate of Egyptian branch/subsidiary, memorandum and articles, board resolution appointing representative, power of attorney, proof of Egyptian address, and banking documents. ETA issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN) for tax filing and VAT registration where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election in Egypt. A foreign LLC may elect to register as a branch of the foreign parent or as a separate Egyptian subsidiary; wholly-owned Egyptian subsidiaries may apply for consolidated/group tax filing under Article 61 of the Egyptian Income Tax Law No. 91/2005. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available under domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual turnover (goods and services) under VAT Law No. 67/2016; registration is mandatory once actual or projected turnover exceeds the threshold during the tax year.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing with ETA clearance for all B2B transactions. Invoices must be transmitted via ETA-approved APIs in XML/JSON format, digitally signed, and stamped with a unique QR code. ETA's e-receipt system applies to B2C transactional sales. Non-integrated suppliers are subject to penalties and inability to deduct input VAT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to movable goods physically exported outside Egypt evidenced by customs export declarations, and to services rendered to non-residents or directly in connection with exported goods, provided legal ownership passes to the recipient abroad and consideration is receivable in foreign currency.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate from an Egyptian licensed bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA denies zero rating where export documentation is incomplete or misdeclared, clawing back all VAT waived plus late penalties of up to 100% of unpaid tax. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract criminal prosecution under Egyptian tax fraud provisions, monetary fines, and potential debarment from e-invoicing/export facilities. ETA matches e-export declarations against customs data and bank foreign currency credit records in automated audit sweeps.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law), supported by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) for investor registration and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) for tax-clearance-linked foreign remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a managed-float exchange rate regime with partial- but administratively liberalized- convertibility. Current-account transactions (trade in goods, services, royalties, technical fees) are fully convertible upon documentary verification by CBE-authorised banks under Article 54 of Law No. 194 of 2020. Capital-account transactions, specifically equity injection, intercompany loans, and liquidation proceeds, require either prior CBE approval or registration under Egyptian Investment Law No. 72 of 2017. Profit and dividend remittance by non-resident shareholders is legally permissible but operationally conditioned on audited financial statements, proof of corporate tax settlement, an ETA tax clearance certificate, and execution through an authorised bank at the prevailing interbank rate; temporary FX liquidity shortages can introduce settlement delays but do not constitute a formal legal prohibition.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory percentage conversion ratio into EGP; the earlier surrender regime was rescinded as part of the 2016 and subsequent CBE exchange reforms. Exporters must repatriate all export proceeds into a foreign-currency account held with an authorised Egyptian bank within 180 days from the date of shipment (airway bill or bill of lading), subject to CBE-granted extensions. Collected proceeds may be retained in USD/EUR, applied to pay import suppliers, or voluntarily sold to the bank. Failure to credit proceeds within the prescribed timeline constitutes a CBE compliance breach, resulting in possible restrictions on import financing, referral to the CBE violations committee, and rejection of future export-credit facilities for the defaulting entity.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (EGP/USD) and Operational EGP Corporate Account
Corporate Operational Dual-Currency Account with Trade Finance / LC Package
Investment Capital Account and Supply-Chain Treasury Operating Account
Operational Current Account (EGP) with Soft Trade Credit Line
Global Banking and Markets Transaction Account with Correspondent Clearing Rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore fintech and electronic money institutions (EMIs) are not licensed by the CBE and cannot hold Capital Escrow Accounts, statutory capital, export proceeds, or execute import settlements for an Egyptian onshore entity; Law No. 194 of 2020 reserves deposit-taking, payment, and money-service activity for CBE-licensed banks and licensed Egyptian payment service providers. A UAE or EU EMI may be used only for incidental operational expenditure (software subscriptions, digital tooling) and must never be presented as the primary treasury channel; any substantial cross-border treasury flow passing through an unlicensed EMI would trigger CBE exchange-control and AML violations, resulting in account freezing and administrative penalties against the LLC.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence during initial onboarding. The CBE's CDD framework, rooted in Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and the CBE's Combatting Money Laundering Regulations, requires an in-person identity verification interview with at least one authorised signatory and each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner owning or controlling 25% or more of the LLC. Remote video onboarding is not generally accepted for a first-time foreign-owned corporate; if no director can travel, the bank dispatches its compliance officer or a CBE-accredited external verifier to the foreign office. Subsequent signatories may be onboarded via a notarised, consular-legalised power of attorney, but the initial KYC dossier must be completed in-country.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unidentified or multi-layer ultimate beneficial owners (UBO) in the offshore parent ownership chain, with any natural person at 25% or more.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register extracts of each corporate layer up to every full UBO, notarised ownership matrix, passport copies of each identified UBO, Egyptian consulate or apostille legalisation with sworn Arabic translation, board resolution naming the authorised bank signatories, and a signed commitment to maintain the UBO registry with any subsequent changes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEP), or high-risk jurisdiction screening flags against any shareholder, director, or contractual counterparty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative sanctions-screening certificate spanning the entire corporate group from a reputable global data provider, PEP self-declaration for each UBO and signatory, board resolution identifying the lawful origin of funds where a PEP relationship exists, group-level compliance attestation, and escalation memorandum to the bank's senior compliance committee where residual PEP risk cannot be entirely eliminated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering suspicion arising from SCADA automation invoices that do not visibly align with physical project milestones or delivery records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original EPC or utility supply contract, proforma invoices and packing lists, air or ocean waybills with corresponding Egyptian customs declarations, progress and milestone completion certificates signed by the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) or private off-taker, site acceptance test reports, and an audited project ledger for the funded contract period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expired Egyptian tax card, unresolved ETA assessments, or gaps in VAT / payroll filing history flagged during bank underwriting.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid and current Egyptian tax card, most recent VAT and payroll filing receipts, an up-to-date ETA tax clearance certificate specifically requested for the capital or profit-remittance transaction, settlement evidence for any historical audits, and an official ETA letter of good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds opacity or unexplained deposits between incorporation, capitalisation, and GAFI project registration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholders' register and EGM minutes approving capital subscription, bank statements showing funds sourced from the parent's balance sheet, parent company audited annual financial statements (IFRS or equivalent GAAP), lawful-source declaration signed by each contributor, and the inward-remittance certificate (bank CIR) issued by the receiving authorised Egyptian bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection from the foreign parent must be routed exclusively through a CBE-authorised Egyptian bank. The parent initiates a SWIFT MT103 wire with the beneficiary name identical to the LLC's Commercial Registry entry, references the GAFI project number, and states the balance-of-payments purpose code for Direct Investment in Egypt (equity capital / share capital increase). The receiving bank lands the funds into a Capital Escrow Account and performs UBO verification, tax-card validation, and commercial-register screening before releasing funds to the LLC operating account. The bank then issues a Certificate of Inward Remittance which the LLC must preserve for subsequent profit repatriation, debt-to-equity conversions, and liquidation clearances. All underlying corporate documents (certificate of incorporation, memorandum of association, board resolution, parent financial statements, passport copies, and Commercial Registry extract) require notarisation, legalisation/apostille, and certified Arabic translation before first drawdown.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the import of PLC modules, SCADA servers, MV switchgear, and substation automation hardware, the primary clearing rail is an irrevocable documentary Letter of Credit confirmed by a reputable overseas correspondent bank, with settlement via SWIFT MT103 / MT202 cover. Services, engineering fees, and low-value subcontract disbursements below the bank's LC threshold are paid through direct SWIFT MT103 operations from the LLC's USD or EGP account. The CBE requires fully documented invoices, and all goods entering Egypt require customs Form 4 / ACI pre-registration referencing the underlying trade contract. A dedicated trade file per transaction must include bill of lading or air waybill, certificate of origin, insurance certificate, packing list, supplier invoice, and site acceptance documentation to satisfy both banking due diligence and future ETA audit queries.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/EGP commercial forward contracts, tenor up to 180 days, strictly back-to-back with verified import or export documentation and not for speculative use.
USD/EGP exchange-traded futures contracts on the Egyptian Exchange (EGX), settled through an approved brokerage and used to hedge confirmed procurement orders.
Cross-currency swaps between EGP and USD executed by a CBE-authorised bank treasury desk for project-financing cash-flow match, subject to CBE no-objection and underlying trade/investment exposure.
FX swaps (spot purchase with simultaneous forward re-sale) employed solely to rebalance working capital between EGP and USD across committed supply-chain obligations.

Offshore USD/EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs): not permissible for onshore Egyptian corporates; excluded by CBE settlement rules requiring actual delivery of funds through the onshore interbank market.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renewal of Trade Registry Entry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Commercial Registration Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the anniversary of commercial registration; for calendar-year registrants, renewal must be completed no later than 31 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-renewal fine of EGP 200 per commenced month; continued non-renewal beyond 60 days triggers administrative suspension, and after 120 days the registrar may strike the company off the Commercial Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Company Tax Return Form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Corporate Tax Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months following the end of the fiscal year (e.g., 30 April for companies with a 31 December year-end; 31 October for a 30 June year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional tax at 2% per month of the unpaid tax, no statutory cap; false declarations are subject to criminal sanctions; tax clearance certificate withheld, blocking certain commercial transactions and license renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and General Assembly Minutes Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Filing Window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual General Assembly must be held within 6 months of fiscal year-end; audited financial statements and minutes are filed with GAFI within 30 days after the AGM, with an absolute outer date of 7 months from fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 20,000 under Companies Law; if the filing is still absent after 180 days, GAFI may initiate compulsory strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Wage Withholding and Social Insurance Reconciliation Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) – Collection Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual reconciliation return due by 31 January following the fiscal year, reconciling monthly contribution declarations and employee lists.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-preservation penalty of 0.5% per month of unpaid contributions; repeated violations may lead to criminal prosecution of the company manager.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is compulsory for every Egyptian LLC; there is no revenue or asset threshold exemption. Under the Companies Law, all limited liability companies must appoint a certified auditor and file audited financial statements with GAFI regardless of turnover or capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which are convergent with IFRS; IFRS as issued may be used for entities subject to Financial Regulatory Authority listing or Appendix Supervisory rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian AML Law and Companies Law impose a continuous UBO register duty. At each Ordinary General Assembly the company must review the beneficial ownership register and confirm any changes to GAFI. In case of share transfer or membership change, the updated register must be lodged with GAFI and the Commercial Registry within 14 days; transfer-related amendments are effective against third parties only after such registration.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 as amended, applicable to juridical persons including an Egyptian Limited Liability Company engaged in electrical installation works (ISIC 4321).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 provides for a 50% reduction of taxable income for up to 5 years for qualifying newly established projects in priority or underdeveloped governorates; free zone projects may apply alternative lump-sum tax treatment; the Suez Canal Economic Zone attracts preferential tax and customs incentives; additional deductions and accelerated depreciation may apply to industrial automation and infrastructure integration activities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 19 (Corporate Income Tax Return) submitted through the unified Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) electronic filing system at www.eta.gov.eg; mandatory e-filing for juridical persons under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 25 of 2020.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year (Article 49 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005); calendar-year taxpayers must file on or before 30 April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the LLC, tax card number, registered address, commercial registration number, ISIC activity code 4321, fiscal year start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign shareholder or non-resident legal representative must attach a notarized power of attorney and the ETA registration certificate of the Egyptian permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross proceeds from SCADA substation automation, PLC integration, project engineering and maintenance contracts; export and local project revenue listed separately.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Egyptian-source income is taxable; foreign-source income of the LLC must be separately itemized and treaty foreign-tax credits computed where applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs of materials, certified subcontract works, technical labor and installation overheads; input invoices must be valid under the Egyptian e-invoicing and e-receipt system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany subcontract or service invoices from non-resident affiliates must comply with arm's-length pricing and transfer pricing documentation; otherwise deductions are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Operating Expenses and Disallowed Items
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, depreciation, insurance and statutory provisions; add-back of non-deductible provisions, capitalized interest, entertainment over statutory caps and related-party management fees lacking substance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign head-office cost allocations must be supported by transfer pricing analyses and service-agreement substance; unsupported allocations are rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Set-off of prior-year tax losses within the 5-year statutory expiration window; loss utilization must follow the chronological order of years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A loss of the Egyptian LLC cannot be transferred to or offset by a foreign shareholder of the entity; the loss remains trapped at the Egyptian entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Tax Due, Credits and Withholding Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of 22.5% corporate tax on adjusted taxable income; deduction of final WHT credits, prepayments and foreign tax credits under an applicable DTA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not entitled to claim the LLC's tax credits; treaty relief claims require a valid tax residence certificate and beneficial ownership statement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory related-party transaction schedule covering services, subcontracts, procurement, financing, management fees and deemed distribution amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The TP-1 form must be attached whenever aggregate related-party transactions exceed the statutory threshold; non-resident counterparties must be identified with treaty and residence details.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an administrative fine of EGP 5,000 to EGP 50,000 under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 25 of 2020; delayed tax payment adds a monthly surcharge of 2% of the unpaid tax per month or fraction thereof; failure to file or submission of a false return permits the ETA to make a best-judgment assessment, triggering an additional 35% premium on the assessed tax; persistent default leads to asset attachment, bank account freezing and travel-ban measures against the legal representative.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final dividend withholding tax under Article 56 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 on profit distributions by an Egyptian LLC to non-resident shareholders; the 10% is applied at source before remittance at the time of dividend approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a tax residence certificate from the residence-country tax authority, legalize/apostille it, submit a beneficial ownership declaration and file a refund claim with the ETA for excess withholding; the Egyptian payer may apply the treaty rate at source only after ETA acceptance of the DTA clearance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 20% on gross amounts (Articles 64 and 67 of Law No. 91 of 2005); applicable DTA rates commonly reduce dividends to 5%–15%, interest to 10%–15% and industrial royalties to 10%–20%, subject to beneficial ownership and economic substance conditions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 8,000,000 aggregate value of related-party transactions in a tax year triggers mandatory preparation of the TP-1 declaration attached to Form 19, full Local File documentation and, for group-wide reporting, a Master File (Ministerial Decree No. 1202 of 2018 as amended).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has not enacted standalone Economic Substance Regulations comparable to Gulf Cooperation Council regimes; however, general anti-avoidance rules under Article 99 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005, substance-over-form doctrines and transfer pricing provisions empower the ETA to disregard artificial or sham transactions; entitlement to treaty benefits requires demonstrable economic activity, personnel, premises and operational substance in the residence jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate suppression of SCADA substation automation contract revenues, fabrication of subcontract invoices, destruction of accounting records, repeated failure to file Form 19 or submission of materially false corporate income tax returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of not less than 6 months and up to 5 years, plus a fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 100,000 under Articles 133–134 of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005; mandatory recovery of evaded tax, a 35% additional assessment premium and a 2% monthly late-payment surcharge; bank account freezes and precautionary asset seizure by the ETA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax shortfall, fines and surcharges; the ETA may impose a travel ban by placing the director on the embarkation embargo list and may attach personal assets where the corporate veil is pierced on grounds of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting the TP-1 declaration, failing to maintain a Local File or Master File for related-party SCADA procurement and integration contracts above EGP 8,000,000, or using margins that deviate from arm's-length standards without contemporaneous evidence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment by the ETA applying best-judgment methodologies with a 35% additional premium and 2% monthly surcharge; administrative fines of up to EGP 100,000 under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 25 of 2020; denial of deductions for undocumented intra-group charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution of the underpaid corporate tax and penalties; where TP documentation is knowingly falsified, criminal liability for tax evasion attaches, including imprisonment, travel bans and disqualification from board positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an Egyptian LLC without a physical office, substantive staff or local management; round-tripping invoices through conduit entities solely to strip profits; claiming DTA reduced withholding rates in the absence of beneficial ownership or residence-country substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard or recharacterization of the arrangement under the Article 99 GAAR; denial of DTA benefits; re-assessment of taxable income at 22.5% with the 35% additional premium; cancellation of the tax card, commercial register dissolution and fraud penalties under Companies Law No. 159 of 2020.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced when the LLC is used as a mere façade; directors become personally liable for evaded corporate tax, fines and damages, and are subject to criminal prosecution, travel bans and potential imprisonment for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Fraud and AML Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to foreign shareholders without the 10% statutory withholding, remitting royalties or interest abroad without the 20% withholding, failing to remit withheld amounts to the ETA, or accepting cross-border wire payments without customer due diligence and without suspicious transaction reporting to the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withheld tax becomes recoverable directly from the legal representative; a 2% monthly surcharge applies; criminal embezzlement penalties apply for non-remittance; AML violations under Law No. 80 of 2002 result in imprisonment of up to 5 years, a fine of EGP 50,000 to EGP 500,000 and asset freezing measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors act as statutory withholding agents and are personally liable for the unremitted WHT amounts, surcharges and criminal fines; principals face imprisonment, departure bans, asset attached execution and personal bankruptcy exposure where fraudulent non-remittance is established.
